caption_used: Три кръгови диаграми, представящи разпределението на предприятията, заетостта и нетния оборот по отрасли — индустрия, строителство, търговия и други услуги — за 2021 г. В първата диаграма (Number of Enterprises) индустрията заема 12%, строителството — 8%, търговията — 27%, а другите услуги — 53%. По отношение на заетостта (Number of Persons Employed), индустрията е с дял от 51%, строителството — 9%, като търговията надвишава другите услуги с дялове съответно 21% и 19%. При нетния оборот (Turnover) индустрията и търговията имат приблизително равни дялове от по 31%, като строителството представлява около 10% (3,2 трилиона), а другите услуги — 28%.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The image displays three donut charts side-by-side, each illustrating the distribution of economic metrics by industry sector for the year 2021. The leftmost chart, labeled "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows that the "OTHER SERVICES" sector accounts for 61% of total enterprises (19.0 million), followed by "TRADE" at 19% (5.9 million), "INDUSTRY" at 12% (3.7 million), and "CONSTRUCTION" at 8% (2.4 million). The middle chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," indicates that "OTHER SERVICES" represent 51% of total employment (80.2 million), "TRADE" accounts for 19% (29.5 million), "INDUSTRY" for 21% (33.0 million), and "CONSTRUCTION" for 9% (13.4 million). The rightmost chart, "TURNOVER," shows "INDUSTRY" and "TRADE" each holding approximately 31% of total turnover (9.8 and 9.9 trillion respectively), "CONSTRUCTION" accounts for 6% (1.9 trillion), and "OTHER SERVICES" for 33% (10.6 trillion). All three charts use a consistent color-coding scheme with a legend at the bottom identifying "INDUSTRY" as gold, "CONSTRUCTION" as blue, "TRADE" as red, and "OTHER SERVICES" as dark blue. Each segment is labeled with its percentage share and absolute value in millions or trillions. The charts are arranged horizontally with the title and subtitle indicating they represent percentages of the total economy and absolute values by NACE Rev. 2 classification.
